name: Prompt chaining
when_to_use: The task splits into fixed sequential steps and each step is easier than the whole.
when_not_to_use: The steps depend on what earlier steps find, so the sequence cannot be fixed in advance.
failure_modes: An early mistake is carried through every later step.
Latency adds up across steps.

cost_profile.note: One model call per step, run in order.

name: Routing
when_to_use: Requests fall into distinct kinds that need different prompts, tools or models.
when_not_to_use: There is one kind of request, or the kinds cannot be told apart reliably.
failure_modes: A request is sent to the wrong handler.
A new request kind has no route.

cost_profile.note: One cheap classification call, then the chosen path.

name: Parallelization
when_to_use: Independent subtasks can run at the same time, or several attempts are voted on.
when_not_to_use: Subtasks depend on each other, or the budget cannot absorb the extra calls.
failure_modes: Results conflict and nothing merges them.
Cost multiplies with the number of branches.

cost_profile.note: Calls scale with branches; latency stays near one branch.

name: Orchestrator and workers
when_to_use: The subtasks are not known in advance and a lead model must plan and delegate them.
when_not_to_use: The subtasks are fixed, or latency is tight.
failure_modes: The orchestrator plans badly or loops.
Worker output is not checked before use.

cost_profile.note: A planning call, several worker calls, and a merge.

name: Evaluator and optimizer
when_to_use: There are clear criteria and a second pass measurably improves the answer.
when_not_to_use: There is no objective criterion, or latency is tight.
failure_modes: The evaluator and the generator agree on a wrong answer.
The loop never converges.

cost_profile.note: A draft and at least one evaluate and revise round.

name: ReAct
when_to_use: The next step depends on tool results and the path cannot be planned up front.
when_not_to_use: A fixed workflow would do, or actions are costly or irreversible.
failure_modes: The agent loops on a failing tool.
A tool result steers the agent off task.

cost_profile.note: A model call per reasoning and action step, unbounded without a cap.

name: Plan and execute
when_to_use: A long task benefits from an explicit plan that is then carried out step by step.
when_not_to_use: The plan would be invalidated by the first result.
failure_modes: The plan is wrong and execution follows it anyway.
Replanning is never triggered.

cost_profile.note: One planning call plus a call per plan step.

name: Reflection
when_to_use: A model can catch its own mistakes when asked to critique with explicit criteria.
when_not_to_use: The model cannot verify the claim without outside information.
failure_modes: The critique rubber-stamps the draft.
Extra rounds add cost without improving quality.

cost_profile.note: A draft plus a critique and rewrite.

name: Handoff and swarm
when_to_use: Specialist agents own different domains and the conversation moves between them.
when_not_to_use: One agent with the right tools can do the job.
failure_modes: Context is lost at a handoff.
Agents hand the task back and forth.

cost_profile.note: Each handoff adds a call and repeats context.

name: Human approval gate
when_to_use: An action is irreversible, costly or regulated, and a person can decide quickly.
when_not_to_use: Nobody is available to approve in time, or approvals would be rubber-stamped at volume.
failure_modes: Approvers rubber-stamp under load.
The queue stalls the whole flow.

cost_profile.note: No extra model calls; human latency is outside the model budget.

name: Retrieval-augmented generation
when_to_use: Answers must be grounded in documents that change or are too large for the prompt.
when_not_to_use: The knowledge is small and static enough to put in the prompt.
failure_modes: Retrieval returns the wrong passages.
The model answers from memory instead of the passages.
The index goes stale.

cost_profile.note: One embedding lookup plus a longer prompt for the answer call.
